Spicy Parsnip Soup

  • Serves 4
  • 45 minutes
  • Source
  • Vegetarian/Vegan
  • Spicy

This warming roast parsnip soup recipe is bursting with aromatic flavour from spices such as cumin and turmeric, whilst mustard seeds give it a slight kick

For the roasted vegetables

  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • 1 tsp coriander seeds
  • 1 tsp cumin seeds, plus extra to garnish
  • ½ tsp ground turmeric
  • ½ tsp mustard seeds
  • 1 large onion, cut into 8 chunks
  • 2 cloves garlic
  • 675g parsnips, diced
  • 2 plum tomatoes, quartered

Heat the oven to 220C/fan 200C/gas 7.

In a bowl, mix together the olive oil, coriander seeds, cumin seeds, turmeric, and mustard seeds.

Add the onion, garlic, parsnips, and tomatoes and mix well.

Spread over a heavy baking sheet and roast for 30 minutes, until tender.

For the soup

  • 1.2L vegetable stock
  • 1 tbsp lemon juice

Spoon the roasted vegetables into a food processor or liquidiser with 600ml of the vegetable stock and process until smooth.

Pour into a pan with the remaining 600ml vegetable stock, season, then heat until barely simmering.

Remove from the heat and stir in the lemon juice. Garnish with cumin seeds.

Built with NYUM. Enjoy!
